chunks.source_title: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Early blight (updated Jun 2023)
chunks.text: पीले किनारे वाले भूरे धब्बे, जिनमें निशाने जैसे गोल छल्ले होते हैं। फल डंठल या बाह्यदल (कैलिक्स) की ओर से संक्रमित होता है; फलों पर भूरे गोल छल्ले।

chunks.source_title: Integrated Pest Management Schedule for Vegetables (national technical bulletin hosted on TNAU Agritech; PDF dated Dec 2012) - tomato sections: Insect management/Tomato (pp. 3-6, incl. IPM package in tomato under polyhouse), Disease management/Tomato (pp. 23-28), Recommended IPM practices - Tomato (pp. 57-58), Annexure VI ETL
chunks.text: Irregular leaf spots mostly appear from marginal portion of leaves. In many tomato cultivars, symptoms are V shaped and progress towards midrib. These lesions are having prominent yellowing on their outer margin due to host specific toxin produced by the pathogen. Mostly disease appears in vegetative phase of plant growth before flowering.

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: This is a common disease of tomato occurring on the foliage at any stage of the growth. The fungus attacks the foliage causing characteristic leaf spots and blight. Early blight is first observed on the plants as small, black lesions mostly on the older foliage.

chunks.source_title: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Early blight (updated Jun 2023)
chunks.text: संक्रमित पौधों के अवशेषों में जीवित रहता है। पहला फैलाव संक्रमित बीज से; बाद में बीजाणु बारिश और हवा से फैलते हैं। गर्म, नम (24-29 डिग्री सेल्सियस), बारिश वाला और गीला मौसम अनुकूल है।

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: Survival and spread: Primary: The fungus spends the winter in infected plant debris in or on the soil where it can survive at least one and perhaps several years. It can also be seed borne.

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: Secondary: The spores are transported by water, wind, insects, other animals including man, and machinery. Once the initial infections have occurred, they become the most important source of new spore production and are responsible for rapid disease spread.

chunks.source_title: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Early blight (updated Jun 2023)
chunks.text: फसल के अवशेष हटाकर नष्ट करें। फसल चक्र अपनाएं।

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: रोग-रोधी या सहनशील किस्में लगाएं। हर मौसम नर्सरी की जगह बदलें, खरपतवार और अपने-आप उगे टमाटर के पौधे हटाएं, सही खाद दें। पास के क्षेत्र में एक के बाद एक चलने वाली फसलें न लगाएं।

chunks.source_title: Integrated Pest Management Schedule for Vegetables (national technical bulletin hosted on TNAU Agritech; PDF dated Dec 2012) - tomato sections: Insect management/Tomato (pp. 3-6, incl. IPM package in tomato under polyhouse), Disease management/Tomato (pp. 23-28), Recommended IPM practices - Tomato (pp. 57-58), Annexure VI ETL
chunks.text: Field sanitation by plucking the lower leaves and burning of infected crop debris. Summer ploughing to increase the desiccation of pathogen and infected plant parts. Minimize relative humidity in plant canopy for preventing the infection.

chunks.source_title: TNAU Agritech Portal, Crop Protection - Tomato: Early blight (updated Jun 2023)
chunks.text: बीज उपचार: ट्राइकोडर्मा एस्पेरेलम 4 ग्राम प्रति किलो बीज।

chunks.note: Label claim (CIB&RC) for early blight, leaf spot and late blight; 500 litres spray solution per hectare.
chunks.source_title: Raghavendra K V, Rekha Balodi, Subhash Chander: Integrated pest management approaches against major insect pests and diseases of tomato. Indian Horticulture (ICAR), Jan-Feb 2023, pp. 39-42
chunks.text: Spray Tebuconazole 50% + Trifloxystrobin 25% WG @ 0.75 g/litre. Label claim (CIB&RC) for early blight, leaf spot and late blight; 500 litres spray solution per hectare.

chunks.note: Label claim (CIB&RC) for late and early blight, leaf spot and bacterial wilt.
chunks.source_title: Raghavendra K V, Rekha Balodi, Subhash Chander: Integrated pest management approaches against major insect pests and diseases of tomato. Indian Horticulture (ICAR), Jan-Feb 2023, pp. 39-42
chunks.text: Spray Copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2-3 g/litre. Label claim (CIB&RC) for late and early blight, leaf spot and bacterial wilt.

chunks.note: Label claim (CIB&RC) for leaf spot, early and late blight. Restricted use in India: confirm with your KVK or agriculture officer before use.
chunks.source_title: Raghavendra K V, Rekha Balodi, Subhash Chander: Integrated pest management approaches against major insect pests and diseases of tomato. Indian Horticulture (ICAR), Jan-Feb 2023, pp. 39-42
chunks.text: Spray Mancozeb @ 2 ml/litre. Label claim (CIB&RC) for leaf spot, early and late blight. Restricted use in India: confirm with your KVK or agriculture officer before use.

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: हर कीटनाशक की प्रतीक्षा अवधि का पालन ज़रूर करें। कटाई से पहले के 7 दिनों में कीटनाशक न डालें। दोपहर में छिड़काव न करें। पत्तियों के नीचे भी छिड़काव करें, खासकर माइट, सफेद मक्खी और स्पोडोप्टेरा के लिए। परजीवी कीट छोड़ने के 7 दिनों के अंदर रासायनिक कीटनाशक न डालें।

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: विस्तृत और नई जानकारी के लिए नज़दीकी KVK, कृषि विश्वविद्यालय या ICAR संस्थान से संपर्क करें।

chunks.source_title: Raghavendra K V, Rekha Balodi, Subhash Chander: Integrated pest management approaches against major insect pests and diseases of tomato. Indian Horticulture (ICAR), Jan-Feb 2023, pp. 39-42
chunks.text: Note: Spray solution required per hectare in tomato crop = 500 litres.

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: In case of pests which are active during night like Spodoptera spray recommended biocides/ chemicals at the time of their appearance in the night.

chunks.source_title: AESA based IPM package for Tomato (IPM package No. 18), 2014
chunks.text: Apply short persistent pesticides to avoid pesticide residue in the soil and produce.

messages: नीचे दिए छिड़काव विकल्प ICAR, NIPHM और TNAU के प्रकाशनों से लिए गए हैं। सिर्फ एक दवा इस्तेमाल करें, लेबल के निर्देश मानें, कटाई से पहले की प्रतीक्षा अवधि का पालन करें और सुरक्षा कपड़े पहनें। संदेह हो तो अपने KVK या कृषि अधिकारी से पुष्टि करें।
